nav.metadataTitle: Tavern — A place for your next adventure
nav.metadataDescription: A free, open-source virtual tabletop. Build little worlds, gather your friends, and tell a great story.

hub.heroDescription: Gather your friends, draw a map, and see where the story takes you. Your next tabletop adventure starts here.
hub.makeItYours: Make it yours, one tile at a time
hub.startDescription: A table for your party. A canvas for your imagination. Just bring a nickname and a good story.
hub.createStep: Create a table and become its game master.
hub.paintStep: Paint forests, rivers, and paths for your party.
hub.shareStep: Share your table code. Everyone sees the same world.
hub.gmDescription: You’ll be the game master of this table.
hub.joinDescription: Grab the code from your game master.
hub.nicknamePlaceholder: What should your party call you?
hub.createFootnote: No signup. No rulebooks. Just your imagination.
hub.joinFootnote: Joined before? We’ll restore your saved seat and nickname.
hub.pickUpStory: Pick up where you left off
hub.unwrittenChapter: The first chapter is still unwritten.
hub.recentDescription: Create or join a table and it will appear here.
hub.footerStories: For the stories you’ll tell together.
hub.footerPlay: Built for play. Open to everyone.
hub.previewAlt: A pixel-art adventure world with roads, river bridges, a town, caverns, a castle and a shrine

tabletop.inviteCopied: Invite link copied. Send it to your party.

tabletop.settingScene: Setting the scene for your next adventure.
tabletop.gmChoosesScene: Your GM chooses the active scene.
tabletop.playerMovementHint: WASD or arrows to move · Click an adjacent tile
tabletop.gmShortcuts: B paint · H pan · M move · 1–0 terrains
tabletop.playerShortcuts: M move · H pan · Scroll to zoom
tabletop.helpSync: Your table stays in sync with everyone in the party. Changes are saved as you paint.
tabletop.helpPaint: Click or drag across tiles. Choose a terrain with 1–9 or 0. Add an optional PNG sprite in the palette.
tabletop.helpPan: Choose the Hand tool (H), hold Alt and drag, or hold the right or middle mouse button and drag with any tool.
tabletop.helpZoom: Scroll, use + / −, or fit the whole map with the crosshair.
tabletop.helpKeyboard: In Paint mode, arrows select a tile and Enter paints. In Move mode (M), WASD and arrows move your character one tile. Click an adjacent tile or drag your token one step. The GM selects players in the party or on the map and can drag them to any valid tile, including while player movement is paused.
tabletop.helpMovement: The lock button allows or pauses player movement. Choose the flag tool to mark a preferred spawn per scene. Players appear there, or on the closest free tile.
tabletop.helpFog: The GM can toggle fog and paint revealed or hidden tiles. Players can move only onto revealed terrain.
tabletop.helpDice: Use the dice log to roll with your party. Type d20, 2d6+3 or 1d12-2 and press Enter, or tap a quick die. The table keeps the last 20 rolls.
tabletop.helpInvite: Share the invite link or table code. Your private GM credential stays in this browser.
tabletop.newSceneDescription: A new place for the story to go. Your whole party will follow you into this scene.
tabletop.renameDescription: Give this chapter a name your party will remember.
tabletop.gmMoveInstructions: Select a player in the party or click their token. Click a destination or drag the player to move them. Arrow keys move the selected player.
tabletop.playerMoveInstructions: Use WASD or arrow keys to move one tile. Click an adjacent tile or drag your token one step.
tabletop.spawnInstructions: Click the preferred spawn tile, or select it with arrows and press Enter.
tabletop.paintInstructions: Drag to paint. Alt-drag or use the Hand tool to pan. Arrow keys select a tile; Enter paints it.
tabletop.panInstructions: Drag to pan. Your game master controls the map.
tabletop.copyCode: Copy this table code and send it to your party: {code}
tabletop.removeDescription: Remove “{name}” and its map? Your party will move to another scene if it is active.
tabletop.keyboardInstructions: Hold the right or middle mouse button and drag to pan with any tool. Scroll or use plus and minus to zoom. Keyboard tile {x}, {y}.

classes.managerDescription: Shape the classes for this table. Subclass modifiers add to class modifiers; buffs and debuffs describe narrative traits.
classes.saveHint: Changes apply when saved. Removing a class or subclass clears that selection from affected characters.
